summary: First-run e2e testing of the Sailing Club Racing app. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass covering auth (officer/admin PIN, wrong PIN, RBAC), public reads (classes/series/boats/rrs-codes/notifications), admin CRUD for boats/classes/series, and the full race lifecycle (create -> select boats -> finish -> undo re-sequence -> adjust position/code -> DSQ -> provisional -> published -> notification cleared -> standings + overall excluding Summer). Frontend: landing page shows Dragon/Sonata/Wayfarer tabs with Overall + sub-series tabs and standings; officer login (sail2026) reaches /officer; admin login (admin2026) reaches /admin with all 4 tabs visible; full officer flow via UI succeeded end-to-end (created Wayfarer Late Autumn R1, toggled boats, recorded finishes, undid, marked provisional, published; race appeared on public landing page).

issues: Wrong-PIN toast/error text was not detectable via generic .error selectors; visually the login page keeps you on /login and 401 shows in console, so behaviour is correct but consider adding data-testid="login-error" for easier testing.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~660 line file; consider splitting into routers (auth, boats, classes, series, races, scoring) for maintainability once feature-set grows.

CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' is invalid per CORS spec; currently harmless because auth uses Bearer tokens (not cookies), but set explicit origins if cookies are ever added.
run_seed only seeds when classes.count==0 — good for idempotency; but there is no way to reseed after wipes without dropping data first (documented behaviour).
adjust_result: setting position for a non-FINISHED code is allowed after code check flow — minor, but consider validation.
record_finish uses next_pos = len(FINISHED)+1 which does not guarantee monotonic time ordering if a boat was previously adjusted. Acceptable for MVP.
test_credentials: Officer PIN sail2026, Admin PIN admin2026 (from backend/.env, verified working).
seed_data_creation: None (relied on auto-seeded 3 classes / 15 series / 10 boats). Created one Wayfarer Late Autumn R1 published race via UI and one Sonata Late Spring race via API (deleted at end of test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. All endpoints and the full lifecycle work. One extra Wayfarer Late Autumn R1 published race remains in DB from UI test (not cleaned). One Dragon Early Spring published demo race pre-existed. Landing page banner correctly hides after publish; notifications endpoint drives the marquee. Admin.jsx has all four tab data-testids (tab-boats/classes/series/historic).
